HPCE.description: Pipe Cooling (HPCE). Defines a pipe-cooling element for heat-of-hydration analysis; ITEMS lists the node keys cooled by the pipe, and START_STAGE/END_STAGE plus START_TIME/END_TIME define the active window of the coolant inflow.

DIAMETER.description: Pipe diameter of the cooling pipe.

START_STAGE.description: Construction stage name at which coolant inflow starts. Hard-validated: must resolve to an existing construction stage (HSTG) name, otherwise the request is rejected. Empty string is not accepted on write.

END_STAGE.description: Construction stage name at which coolant inflow ends. Hard-validated: must resolve to an existing construction stage (HSTG) name, otherwise the request is rejected. Empty string is not accepted on write.

START_TIME.description: Elapsed time (within START_STAGE) at which coolant inflow starts. Combined with START_STAGE to compute the absolute total time.

END_TIME.description: Elapsed time (within END_STAGE) at which coolant inflow ends. Combined with END_STAGE to compute the absolute total time.

ITEMS.description: List of node keys (node numbers) cooled by this pipe cooling element.
